desc: Offline: build the ticket-211 stage-1 write payload once probe 5001 has pinned the rebuilt exFAT 'linux' partition (label, GPT type EBD0A0A2-B9E5-4433-87C0-68B6B72699C7, start/size). Same kernel/DTB/m1n1 as 6001 run 3. Init: 6001 topology+identity gates, then exact partition pins (abort on any mismatch, never by partition number); n1, other partitions, n2/n3 read-only; fsck.exfat -n before; mount the partition rw; write a deterministic 1 GiB pattern file, fsync, sha256; umount; fsck.exfat -n; remount ro; re-verify sha256; log block stats; printk.devkmsg=on. Plus host checker and a second-boot verify mode. Two identical builds, preflight, independent review. Writes confined to that one exFAT partition per CJ's 2026-08-03 rule.
author: claude

hashes.bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel printk.devkmsg=on console=ttydc0 console=tty0 nvmewrite=write|verify nvmewritedir=TAG [nvmewc=through] [nvmeend=reboot] rdinit=/init (exact boot-dcuart CMDLINE; preflight OK all four)
hashes.run: PAYLOAD=nvme-exfat-write-20261025b/payload WRITE_ARGS='nvmewritedir=TAG [nvmewc=through]' scripts/t6040-run-nvme-write.sh write|verify <run-dir>; same TAG on verify
